symptom: describe → exec of a nanoflow detaches every annotation from its activity (AnnotationFlows 3 → 0, so the next describe prints the notes as free-floating) and deletes ExportLevel, UseListParameterByReference and ReturnVariableName; MarkAsUsed is cleared. Rules drop their annotation flows too
cause: nanoflowToGen and ruleToGen never wrote ObjectCollection.AnnotationFlows (microflowToGen did), and nanoflowToGen never set the three header keys; nanoflowFromGen did not read ReturnVariableName or MarkAsUsed and the builder hardcoded MarkAsUsed false
insight: Three flow flavours share the object/flow converters but each has its own top-level writer, and each dropped a different subset — grep every *ToGen for the same list loop, not just the reported one. For keys with no MDL spelling and unknown version floors (Nanoflow.ExportLevel, UseListParameterByReference), carry ONLY the keys the stored unit has: nothing was ever written on create, Studio Pro fills an absent key, and an undeclared one makes the unit unopenable
